title: Rail thermal buckling
line: A thermal buckling FEA study of a steel rail fixed at both ends and warmed 10 K.
description: Thermal buckling of a steel rail, 2000 mm long with a 20 x 10 mm section, fixed at both ends and warmed 10 K. The ends stop it growing, so the warming becomes axial compression. A thermal step, a preload and a buckling step return the load factor on the 10 K rise at which the rail buckles, and the buckled shape.
thumbnailAlt: Buckled shape of a steel rail fixed at both ends after warming, solved in RunMat
